generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
GST Shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The tender fee is non-refundable.
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka Public Procurement Portal.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class-1, Class-2, Class-3 Registration and the tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.07 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.07, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the orginal documents before approval.

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, labour, loading, unloading, transportation, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, and all other incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge of this work.
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

In case if the death of a contractor, after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if an eligible registered contractor and is willing, can execute and complete the work, at the accepted tender rates, irrespective of the cost of the work.
The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per rates provided in prevailing Govt orders at the time of execution

All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work. Department will not supply any materials.

The tenderer should submit proposed methodology and programme of construction backed with equipment and material planning, & deployment duly supported with broad calculation and quality management , plan, proposed to be adopted justifying their capability of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications and within the stipulated period of completion.

Materials like bitumen, steel,cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority at his cost before used on the work.

All documents should be uploaded by the contractor is to be attested by the authorized notary or an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and should be produced for verification at any stage of process as and when saught for. Failure to produce original documents leads to rejection of Tender.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty-first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Units, Rates & Prices shall be quoted by the tender in Indian Rupees only
Item for which no rates or price has been entered in will not be paid for by the Employer when executed & shall be deemed covered by the other rates & prices in the bill of quantities.
The field Lab/Mobile Lab shall be preferably located, adjacent to the site with the required amenities as per the clause. Failing which 1% of the amount of work done will be penalized.

Tenderer shall obtain the Work done Certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bids for physical verification.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid documents carefully and upload the necessary documents before submission of their bid.
To qualify for award of this Contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per KW-3
Payment of EMD of shall be through E-Payment in favour of Executive Engineer, and shall be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of Tender

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer PWD, PRAMC, during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday the next working day will hold good in lieu of the dates mentioned.
The contractor should maintain the work during the defective liability period, i.e. for 2 years after the completion of work at his own cost.
GST Shall be paid to the tendered amount separately

The Bidders shall note that the information furnished in technical Bid will be evaluated with respect to the Technical requirement Criteria set forth in the Bid Document, which is uploaded separately. The Bids meeting the minimum Technical criteria at the discretion of the Engineer-in-Charge shall only be qualified for financial Evaluation of Financial Bids.

PERFORMANCE SECURITY: As per Go No. FD/611 Exp-12/2023, Bengaluru Dt: 03.02.2024, Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price payable shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire Security deposit will be deducted from the final bill.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
